review_oversight: Before D2, the review isolated hwloc as the apparent local cause but did not classify all D1 events. Full D1 trace later showed two classes and four already-present network-library setter events: two libinfinipath and two libpsm2. D2 only scoped out the x86 hwloc component; those calls were not new. This was incomplete pre-D2 review by the supervising process, not an S2 or numerical-method failure.
